DIAGNOSIS READY: ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis).

The progression of lower limb weakness, bladder dysfunction, and bulbar symptoms (speech slurring) over several months is highly characteristic of motor neuron disease. I will proceed with diagnostic testing to confirm the clinical suspicion.
